_comment: Site normalcy for the Komati stub. Cues explained by ordinary site activity are suppressed as NOISE, never as authorisation: every suppression is recorded through CueAdapter.onSuppression so a widened window is visible in the audit (docs/THREAT_MODEL.md A3). Times are site-local (SAST, UTC+120) minutes since midnight; days are 0=Sunday..6=Saturday.
